title: Pure Kaiser Glider
summary: Seto Kaiba's Kaiser Glider strategy is a Level 6 LIGHT Dragon Tribute, Quick-Play revival, and Rank 6 Xyz deck led by Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst. Tribute any monster on your field (such as Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit or Neo Kaiser Sea Horse) as a Quick Effect to Special Summon Golden Burst from your hand and copy its Level, or discard Neo Kaiser Glider to revive a Dragon from the GY while Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres and Rank 6 Xyz monsters control the board.

allow.Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit: Level 6 LIGHT Dragon that Special Summons itself when only the opponent controls a monster; when Tributed by Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst (Quick Effect), Tefnuit summons Labradorite Dragon from the Deck while Golden Burst becomes Level 6!
allow.Hieratic Dragon of Su: Level 6 LIGHT Dragon that Special Summons itself by Tributing a Hieratic (triggering Tefnuit) and tributes a Dragon to destroy an opponent's Spell/Trap.
allow.Labradorite Dragon: Level 6 DARK Dragon Normal Tuner summoned from the Deck whenever Tefnuit or Su is Tributed by Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst, enabling instant Rank 6 Xyz or Level 12 Synchro plays!
allow.Hieratic Seal of Convocation: Spell that searches Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit or Hieratic Dragon of Su directly from the Deck.
allow.Starliege Seyfert: Level 4 LIGHT Dragon that sends itself or a Level 6 Dragon from hand/field to GY to search Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst or Neo Kaiser Glider, and banishes from GY to recover a Level 6/8 Dragon.
allow.Hieratic Dragon King of Atum: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz made with Level 6 Kaiser Glider + Labradorite Dragon that detaches 1 material to Special Summon any Dragon directly from the Deck.
allow.Constellar Ptolemy M7: Rank 6 LIGHT Xyz made with two Level 6 Kaiser Gliders or stacked over Atum that bounces a monster from the field or GY to the hand.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz made with two Level 6 Dragons that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card your opponent controls.
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 LIGHT Dragon that tributes itself or a Dragon on the opponent's turn to bounce a face-up card and Special Summon Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst directly from the Deck!

main: Signature Level 6 LIGHT Dragon (2400 ATK): Quick Effect to Tribute 1 monster you control and Special Summon itself from hand with that monster's original Level, and lowers an opponent's monster's ATK to 2400 on summon.
Level 6 LIGHT Dragon (2400 ATK): discards itself and 1 monster to Special Summon 1 Dragon Normal Monster from your GY, and reduces all monsters your opponent controls by 500 ATK when sent to the GY.

Original Level 6 LIGHT Dragon (2400 ATK / 2200 DEF): cannot be destroyed by battle with a monster that has the same ATK, and bounces 1 monster on the field to the hand when destroyed and sent to the GY.

Level 4 LIGHT Dragon Tuner: Special Summons itself from hand while you control a LIGHT Tuner/Dragon, modulates a LIGHT Tuner's Level by 1, and sends Kaiser Glider or Neo Kaiser Glider from Deck to GY when sent from field to GY!
Special Summons itself when your opponent controls a monster; when Tributed for Kaiser Glider or Golden Burst, it Special Summons Level 6 Labradorite Dragon from the Deck for an instant Rank 6 Xyz!
Tributes Tefnuit to Special Summon itself and trigger Labradorite Dragon, then overlays with Kaiser Glider into Rank 6 Atum or Evolzar Lars.
Level 6 Dragon Normal Tuner summoned from Deck by Tefnuit/Su and revived from GY by Neo Kaiser Glider.
Sends a Level 6 Dragon to the GY to search Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst, Kaiser Glider, or Neo Kaiser Glider from your Deck.
Adds Hieratic Dragon of Tefnuit or Hieratic Dragon of Su from your Deck to your hand.
extra: Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2 Dragon: bounces a face-up card on the opponent's turn by Tributing itself, then Special Summons Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst directly from your Deck.
Rank 6 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 6 Dragons): detaches 1 material to Special Summon Kaiser Glider - Golden Burst or Neo Kaiser Glider directly from your Deck.
Rank 6 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 6 Dragons): detaches 1 material when your opponent activates a card or effect to negate any face-up card they control.
Rank 6 LIGHT Xyz that stacks over Atum or uses two Level 6 Kaiser Gliders to bounce a monster from field or GY.
